decision: SHELVE standalone clock/state paper at scientific-value/metadata gate
validity: Real public EMC arrays exist. Their values were not inspected, so no positive or negative methylation-state result was measured. Source authentication and matching checks are valid within their stated metadata scope.
value: A numerical descriptor lacks a replicated interpretable contrast: individual age is absent in the reference cohort and controls, comparator histology differs by matched slide, three EMCs are unmatched, and batch/purity/cell-history alternatives and sarcoma clock transport remain unresolved. One previously published Case 21 with age 35 and high mitotic activity cannot rescue it. Recreating diagnostic classes or flat CNV adds no new useful disease finding.
automatic_followthrough: Checked all ten reference EMCs and 62 fixed controls across platform/supplier/date/slide, all 1,505 GSM metadata records, the epiTOC2 primary methods and 2024 improved-counter contrary evidence; checked the independent MET-study S2 age/proliferation annotations and retained broader source gaps.
larger_matrix_stage: Not initiated because interpretability/value failed before outcomes. The 5.29 GB matrix size was reported to the lead and is not a scientific unsuitability reason. Matrices and extra Case 21 values remain pending accessible analysis.
strongest_alternative: Age, source/chip, normalization, cell mixture and tissue/cancer-specific methylation maintenance can produce cumulative-score differences independent of current proliferation.
reopen: Authenticated case-linked ages and independent mitotic/state/clinical measurements with comparable controls and source replication; validated shared probes/normalization and appropriate tumor-mixture treatment; complete relevant public EMC coverage. Existing arrays alone do not support a causal proliferation or clinically useful marker interpretation.
